title: narcissus tazetta var. canariensis
intro: Narcissus tazetta var. canariensis, commonly known as the Canarian daffodil or Canarian narcissus, is a species of flowering plant in the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including anxiety, insomnia, and depression, thanks to its health benefits of promoting relaxation and reducing stress levels. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus tazetta var. canariensis include its sedative and anxiolytic effects, which can help to calm the mind and body, as well as its ability to reduce inflammation and improve mood. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include alkaloids, such as galanthamine and lycorine, which have been shown to have analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties.
